risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and presents strong year-over-year recovery, improved margins, positive net income, cash, and no outstanding debt. Key risks include pandemic-related uncertainty, worker shortages, supply-chain disruptions, and reliance on continued recovery in client demand. Forward-looking claims about technology benefits and market normalization are somewhat generalized but not unusually evasive.
